elements.element: Services are performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: Subsection (a) expressly warrants that the Services, including Hosting Services and Support Services, will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.

elements.element: Software conforms to its documentation for 12 months following delivery.
elements.evidence: Subsection (b) provides that, for 12 months following delivery, the Interface and all related software will conform to their documentation.

elements.element: Deliverables conform to their documentation for 12 months following delivery.
elements.evidence: Subsection (b) expressly includes “all deliverables” in the 12-month documentation-conformance warranty.

elements.element: Services conform to their documentation for 90 days following performance.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) warrants for 90 days following performance that the Services will conform to their documentation.

elements.element: Repair is available as a remedy for breach of the warranties.
elements.evidence: The remedy sentence states that Client's remedy for breach of the foregoing warranties includes repair.

elements.element: Replacement is available as a remedy for breach of the warranties.
elements.evidence: The remedy sentence states that Client's remedy for breach of the foregoing warranties includes replacement.

elements.element: A refund is available as a remedy for breach of the warranties.
elements.evidence: The remedy sentence provides for a refund of fees paid for the non-conforming Interface, software, deliverable, or Services.

elements.element: TrueLink complies with laws applicable to its performance under the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Subsection (e) expressly warrants that TrueLink will comply with all laws applicable to its performance under the Agreement.

elements.element: The software is free of malicious code.
elements.evidence: Subsection (d) expressly warrants that the Interface and all related software will be free of malicious code.

elements.element: Software conforms to its documentation for 90 days following delivery.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause provides a longer 12-month software conformance warranty following delivery, which necessarily covers the fallback 90-day period.

elements.element: Services conform to their documentation for 30 days following performance.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause provides a longer 90-day Services conformance warranty following performance, which necessarily covers the fallback 30-day period.

elements.element: Repair is available as a remedy for breach of the warranties.
elements.evidence: The remedy sentence expressly includes repair.

elements.element: Replacement is available as a remedy for breach of the warranties.
elements.evidence: The remedy sentence expressly includes replacement.

elements.element: A refund is available as a remedy for breach of the warranties.
elements.evidence: The remedy sentence expressly includes a refund of applicable fees paid.

result.reason: The operative addition satisfies every preferred requirement, including the longer warranty periods, and therefore also satisfies the fallback durations. It adds only the requested performance, conformance, legal-compliance, malicious-code, and remedy protections. The existing disclaimer is expressly subject to warranties stated in the Agreement and therefore does not negate the additions. Drafting is generally strong, although the remedy provision could more clearly specify who elects among repair, replacement, and refund and the timing for providing the selected remedy.
